name: rhosts-trust
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: plants a legacy r-services trust file (.rhosts or /etc/hosts.equiv), by default containing '+ +' (trust everyone with no password). Vars: TARGET (optional, default /root/.rhosts); CONTENT (optional, default '+ +'); OWNER (optional).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
target="${TARGET:-/root/.rhosts}"
content="${CONTENT:-+ +}"
install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$target")"
printf '%s\n' "$content" > "$target"
chmod 0644 "$target"
if [ -n "${OWNER-}" ]; then chown "$OWNER" "$target" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
